item.name: Gometa (SSJ4)
item.unlockRoute: Primal Fusion after the Primal Core checklist; requires maxed Goki (SSJ4 Full Power) and Vegata (SSJ4 Full Power).
item.passiveEffect: Stacks damage, defense, dodge, and crit-chance growth from teammate deaths and kills.
item.bestUse: Long-fight carry for Story, Raids, and Infinite once the account can support the fusion route.
item.investmentPriority: Endgame target; plan materials and parent-unit leveling before spending cubes elsewhere.
item.cardSummary: Plan Gometa as the late-game fusion carry, not as a normal banner pull.

item.name: Woo (Shadow)
item.unlockRoute: Limited banner; available evidence points to an extremely rare chase with a possible pity path.
item.passiveEffect: Skill activation grants a short dodge window and mana generation; kills can convert enemies into Shadow Soldiers.
item.ultimateOrActive: Frenzy Slash spender that uses mana for burst damage.
item.bestUse: High-damage Infinite or long-wave unit when the player can afford a rare limited chase.
item.investmentPriority: Only chase after core economy and reliable carry slots are stable.
item.cardSummary: A rare limited Secret with ramping shadow-soldier value in longer waves.

item.name: Madora (Gunbai)
item.unlockRoute: Ninja Village Act 4 boss route, with a low listed drop chance.
item.passiveEffect: Skill attacks apply Burn, and chakra overdrive improves damage and cooldown pressure.
item.bestUse: Boss-health pressure and raid fights where damage over time matters.
item.investmentPriority: Strong farm target when repeat boss clears are more realistic than banner luck.
item.cardSummary: A farmable Secret burn unit for raid and boss damage checks.

item.name: Shanron (Omega)
item.unlockRoute: Ultimate Evil Raid, with better odds on normal clears than hard-mode clears.
item.passiveEffect: Deals extra boss damage and rotates elemental modes that add corruption, damage-over-time, or movement-slow pressure.
item.bestUse: Raid and boss-focused teams, especially after Maximum Yen upgrades can handle the deploy cost.
item.investmentPriority: High for raid accounts, but delay on fresh accounts until economy can support it.
item.cardSummary: A raid-focused Secret built around boss damage and corruption utility.

item.name: Puppeteer (Transcendent)
item.unlockRoute: Evolve Puppeteer using Katakara challenge materials.
item.passiveEffect: Amplifies self damage and reduces incoming damage during active skill windows.
item.bestUse: Stable long-run carry when a team needs both damage and frontline durability.
item.investmentPriority: High-end evolution target after the account has economy and one main carry.
item.cardSummary: A resource-heavy evolved Secret that mixes frontline survival with wide AOE damage.

item.name: Rizzuto (Sage)
item.passiveEffect: Builds a charge meter that can grant damage and defense aura bonuses to Nature-type allies.
item.bestUse: Boss and mid-game damage support when the front line can keep aura setup stable.
item.investmentPriority: Good after Maximum Yen improves early deployment timing.
item.cardSummary: A support DPS that rewards stable lanes and Nature-focused setups.

item.name: Vegata (SSJ4 Full Power)
item.unlockRoute: Gacha, then awaken from base Vegata into the SSJ4 Full Power form.
item.passiveEffect: Galick Gun barrage scales with wave count and attack speed.
item.bestUse: Mid-game carry and required parent for the Gometa fusion route.
item.investmentPriority: Worth leveling even after it stops being the main lane carry because it feeds the fusion plan.
item.cardSummary: A Legendary fusion parent that can still carry mid-game lanes.

item.name: Goki (SSJ4 Full Power)
item.unlockRoute: Gacha, then awaken to SSJ4 with Eclipse God Stone and Gold.
item.passiveEffect: Below half HP, gains damage, ability damage, and lifesteal; also functions as a true anti-air path for flyer lanes.
item.bestUse: Flyer lanes, mid-game damage, and required parent for Gometa fusion.
item.investmentPriority: High because it solves anti-air pressure and feeds the late-game fusion path.
item.cardSummary: The SSJ4 Goki line is both anti-air coverage and half of the Gometa plan.

item.name: Shinks
item.passiveEffect: Gives nearby allies defensive support through damage reduction and dodge help.
item.bestUse: Defensive support slot that buys time for upgrades and carry setup.
item.investmentPriority: Useful when a team has damage but needs wave control and survival help.
item.cardSummary: A support unit for protecting the main lane while carries ramp.

item.name: Rudaus
item.passiveEffect: Reduces his own ability cooldown and gives nearby allies a smaller ability-cooldown reduction.
item.bestUse: Cooldown support for lineups that depend on frequent skill casts.
item.investmentPriority: Test with the main DPS first; cooldown support is strongest when the carry benefits from it.
item.cardSummary: A cooldown support unit for skill-heavy teams.

item.name: Mamosa
item.passiveEffect: Allies in range regenerate HP based on Mamosa's max HP.
item.bestUse: Early and mid-game protection while players learn Acts and stabilize lanes.
item.investmentPriority: Good temporary support; do not over-invest once boss damage outpaces healing.
item.cardSummary: A healer that helps early lanes survive before endgame burst becomes the wall.

item.name: Shield Hero
item.unlockRoute: Unlock path needs confirmation; listed paths include Battle Pass and gacha/campaign availability.
item.passiveEffect: Redirects or intercepts part of the damage aimed at allies.
item.bestUse: Frontline survival slot for raids or stages where chip damage threatens the back line.
item.investmentPriority: Good practical tank before late-game fusion options are ready.
item.cardSummary: A practical tank choice while building toward stronger endgame options.

item.name: Big Beard
item.passiveEffect: Missing HP increases Defense up to a cap.
item.bestUse: Temporary bruiser or tank slot until stronger survival units are available.
item.investmentPriority: Low-to-medium; useful early, but not a primary endgame target.
item.cardSummary: A bruiser-style tank whose value comes from surviving at lower HP.

item.name: Fastwagon
item.passiveEffect: Increases money generation while alive and grants extra Yen on death.
item.bestUse: Economy slot that helps expensive units come online earlier during waves.
item.investmentPriority: High for new accounts because income is harder to replace than raw damage.
item.cardSummary: The dedicated Yen unit for speeding up deployments and upgrades.

item.name: Karashi (Sharingan)
item.passiveEffect: Marked targets take faster follow-up hits and added crit pressure.
item.bestUse: Fast Act clearing and speed farming before enemy HP scales too high.
item.investmentPriority: Worth using when pulled early; lower priority than the main endgame carry path.
item.cardSummary: A speed-clear unit for farming lower-pressure stages quickly.

item.name: Zemitsu
item.passiveEffect: Periodically enters Sleep Mode for damage, cooldown, and ability-cooldown boosts.
item.bestUse: Early speed-clear slot before stronger Mythic or Legendary DPS units replace it.
item.investmentPriority: Good early pull, but stop heavy investment once better DPS arrives.
item.cardSummary: A fast early DPS that falls off once stronger damage units arrive.

item.name: Ramuru
item.passiveEffect: Kills absorb Max HP into Ramuru's damage up to a cap.
item.bestUse: Cheap early DPS filler until higher-tier units take the lane.
item.investmentPriority: Low; use briefly and recycle or bench after stronger pulls.
item.cardSummary: A starter-friendly DPS filler with limited long-term scaling.

item.name: Choi
item.passiveEffect: Simple combo chain without meaningful scaling hooks.
item.bestUse: Early Act body when the player needs any lane filled.
item.investmentPriority: Low; replace at the first reliable B-tier or better pull.
item.cardSummary: A low-priority early DPS placeholder.

item.name: Tranks
item.passiveEffect: Melee crits can briefly stun nearby targets.
item.bestUse: Temporary hybrid filler in early or mid Acts.
item.investmentPriority: Low; do not carry it into raid progression unless roster options are thin.
item.cardSummary: A filler hybrid whose brief crit stun is useful only while options are limited.

item.name: Zaro
item.passiveEffect: Ability attacks apply Bleed that damages over time and reduces regeneration.
item.ultimateOrActive: Executioner resets ability cooldown after a kill, with a cooldown.
item.bestUse: Early lane DPS with bleed utility before better units replace it.
item.investmentPriority: Low-to-medium; useful early, but do not over-invest for endgame.
item.cardSummary: A bleed-focused DPS that works early but is not a long-term carry.

item.name: Shin
item.passiveEffect: Ability attacks apply Burn, and repeated ability casts stack extra Burn damage up to a cap.
item.bestUse: Early DPS filler when burn pressure helps basic progression.
item.investmentPriority: Low; replace when stronger burn or burst units arrive.
item.cardSummary: A burn-based early DPS that should be replaced by stronger carries.

item.name: Igras
item.passiveEffect: Weak dagger attacks with no meaningful scaling hook.
item.bestUse: Starter body for the first pulls and first lanes.
item.investmentPriority: Very low; avoid Stat Cube spending.
item.cardSummary: A starter unit to replace before any serious reroll spending.

item.name: Michigo
item.passiveEffect: At half HP, gains Speed and Damage until death.
item.bestUse: Low-ceiling filler when no better lane unit is available.
item.investmentPriority: Very low; recycle or bench after better pulls.
item.cardSummary: A low-priority DPS filler with a half-HP self-buff.

item.name: Asto
item.passiveEffect: Takes reduced ability damage.
item.bestUse: Temporary early body with a defensive passive.
item.investmentPriority: Very low; do not spend major reroll items.
item.cardSummary: A short-term filler whose defensive passive does not justify long-term investment.

item.name: Goki
item.passiveEffect: Every third attack gains extra ability damage.
item.bestUse: Base-form stepping stone toward the SSJ4 line, not a long-term carry.
item.investmentPriority: Low for combat, but keep progression needs in mind if pursuing Goki SSJ4 and Gometa.
item.cardSummary: Base Goki is mainly useful as a stepping stone toward stronger forms.

item.name: Mab
item.passiveEffect: Every third attack deals extra damage.
item.bestUse: Early roster body while waiting for stronger DPS.
item.investmentPriority: Very low; replace quickly.
item.cardSummary: A simple early DPS filler with every-third-attack damage.

item.name: Muffy
item.passiveEffect: Gains a base Dodge chance.
item.bestUse: Early filler when the roster is still thin.
item.investmentPriority: Very low; never a priority cube target.
item.cardSummary: A low-priority brawler whose dodge passive is not enough for long-term investment.
